turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Of course! I will do one first.
I have a pen.
I say "pen" and listen to the start: "p". That is not a vowel sound, so I write a.
So: a before other sounds, an before vowel sounds.
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: I have an pen.

Your turn now. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
